description: Google Search. Scrape Google Search results via API and retrieve structured SERP data with pagination. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

cr.description: Limit results to one or more countries. Use country{XX} with | as delimiter (e.g. countryFR|countryDE).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

gl.description: Country to use for the Google search. Two-letter country code (e.g. us for the United States, uk for United Kingdom, or fr for France).

google_domain.description: Google domain to use for the search. Defaults to google.com. Default: "google.com".

hl.description: Language to use for the Google search. Two or three-letter language code (e.g. en, es, fr), optionally followed by a region code (e.g. en-gb, es-419).

location.description: Human-readable location to originate the search from (e.g. New York, NY, Paris, France). If several locations match, the most popular one is used. Note: location and uule cannot be used together.

lr.description: Limit results to one or more languages. Use lang_{xx} with | as delimiter (e.g. lang_fr|lang_de).

num.description: Maximum number of results to return per page (deprecated). Default: 10.

page.description: Page number / offset used for pagination. Default: 1.

query.description: The search query you want to run on Google (supports advanced operators like site:, inurl:, intitle:).

safe.description: Adult content filter. active enables Google SafeSearch; off disables it. Omit to use Google default.

tbs.description: Advanced search filters string (e.g. time ranges: qdr:h last hour, qdr:d last day, qdr:w last week, qdr:m last month, qdr:y last year).

uule.description: Google encoded location parameter. Use for precise geo targeting. Note: uule and location cannot be used together.

name: google_search
title: Google Search
